newsitem.title: JAPAN: Ex-Im Bank of Korea launches $500 mln global bonds.
newsitem.headline: Ex-Im Bank of Korea launches $500 mln global bonds.

text.p: The Export-Import Bank of Korea on Tuesday launched $500 million worth of five-year global bonds due February 10, 2002, Morgan Stanley said.
The bonds will be priced at a spread of 44 to 46 basis points above the five-year U.S. Treasury note during New York trading later today, the joint lead-manager said.
They are rated at A1 by Moody's Investors Service and double A minus (AA-) by Standard & Poor's Corp.
The payment date will be February 10.
The other lead manager is Salomon Brothers. Co-lead managers are Daiwa Securities, Lehman Brothers, Merrill Lynch and SBC Warburg.
